get.description:
Typed settings for one area, e.g. ``general`` or ``billing`` (FR-02-5).

``schema`` describes each setting so the frontend can render the form. With
``?branch=<id>``, ``values`` are the effective values for that branch and
``overrides`` lists the keys set at branch level.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch id: read or override branch-level values.

One registered setting. Fields are declared in get_fields() because names such as
``label`` and ``help_text`` clash with attributes of DRF's Field class.
